name: System Architecture Diagram
description: Create Mermaid diagrams for system architecture and components
helpContent: Generate Mermaid diagrams for visualizing architecture. Mermaid supports flowcharts, sequence diagrams, and more for architecture documentation.
template:
Create a Mermaid diagram showing:
1. System components
2. Component relationships
3. Data/API interactions
4. External services

Use appropriate Mermaid diagram type (graph, sequence, etc).

name: Component Interactions
description: Mermaid sequence diagram showing component interactions
helpContent: Design sequence diagrams in Mermaid showing how different components interact over time.
template:
Generate a Mermaid sequence diagram showing:
1. Actors/Components involved
2. Sequence of interactions
3. Messages passed between components
4. Decision points
5. Final outcomes

Clearly show request/response patterns.
